dispatch_actual.training_reason: First representative training snapshot free3220MiB; floor((3220-2048)/(1.2*3800))=0 additional slots. WDDM process attribution unavailable; no second worker forced.
dispatch_actual.sampling_reason: Second arm dispatched after first was resident and producing registered outputs; second load snapshot free5691MiB exceeds original guard2048+1.2*2600=5168MiB. Separate processes and outputs; call windows only partially overlap.
dispatch_actual.D0_reason: After D0 resident snapshot free4498MiB, another provisional2600MiB worker fails2048+1.2*2600 headroom rule; process attribution unavailable. D0 stayed serial.
dispatch_actual.caution: Host call intervals and worker envelopes are not CUDA kernel traces. This run is not an isolated speed benchmark and makes no measured parallel speedup claim.

limitations: WDDM per-process used_gpu_memory is NA in both Windows and WSL. No attributable process VRAM peak was measured.
torch allocated/reserved values are reset-scoped allocator peaks, not full-process usage; sampled whole-card usage includes unrelated programs.
GPU utilization readings vary with sampling and user activity; no CUDA kernel trace or isolated concurrency throughput experiment was run.
C-only provenance is supported by frozen entrypoint source inspection plus allowlist and receipt, not an OS file-access trace.
